full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the "Implementation Opinions on Lawfully and Properly Handling Property Rights Cases Formed in History"

Fa Fa [2016] No. 28

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Supreme People's Court's "Implementation Opinions on Lawfully and Properly Handling Property Rights Cases Formed in History" are hereby issued to you. Please implement them conscientiously in light of local conditions.

November 28, 2016

Implementation Opinions on Lawfully and Properly Handling Property Rights Cases Formed in History

In order to implement the "Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on Improving the Property Rights Protection System and Legally Protecting Property Rights" (hereinafter referred to as the "Opinions"), give full play to the trial functions of the people's courts, and lawfully and properly handle property rights cases formed in history, the following implementation opinions are hereby put forward.

I. Fully recognize the significance of lawfully and properly handling property rights cases formed in history

1. Lawfully and properly handling property rights cases formed in history is a major measure to comprehensively implement the central authorities' decisions and deployments on improving the property rights protection system and legally protecting property rights. Strengthening property rights protection is an inevitable requirement for adhering to the basic socialist economic system, an inevitable requirement for completing the building of a moderately prosperous society in all respects, an inevitable requirement for consolidating the social foundation for the Party's long-term governance, and also an inevitable requirement for maintaining the country's long-term stability and security. Lawfully and properly handling property rights cases formed in history is an important content and major measure of the central authorities' decisions and deployments on strengthening property rights protection. It is of great significance for improving the modern property rights system and promoting the rule of law in property rights protection; for enhancing the people's sense of security in their property and wealth, enhancing social confidence, and forming good expectations; for creating a fair, just, transparent, and stable legal environment and stimulating the entrepreneurial and innovative vitality of various economic entities; and for maintaining social fairness and justice and promoting sustained and healthy economic and social development.

2. Lawfully and properly handling property rights cases formed in history is a major and urgent political task for the people's courts. The Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core attaches great importance to property rights protection. The Third, Fourth, Fifth, and Sixth Plenary Sessions of the 18th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China all had clear requirements. This year, the Party Central Committee and the State Council made special systematic decisions and deployments on improving the property rights system and legally protecting property rights, and made clear divisions of labor for relevant central departments to implement them, designating the lawfully and proper handling of property rights cases formed in history as a task for the people's courts. People's courts at all levels must be politically conscious, think in terms of the big picture, effectively unify their thoughts and actions with the central authorities' decisions and deployments, and from the height of coordinating the advancement of the "Five-in-One" overall plan and the "Four Comprehensives" strategic layout, enhance their sense of responsibility and mission, with a spirit of daring to take responsibility and courage to overcome difficulties, give full play to the role of trial functions, and resolutely complete this major political task.

3. Lawfully and properly handling property rights cases formed in history is a trial work with strong legal and policy dimensions. Property rights cases formed in history often span a long time and have complex causes. Properly handling such cases has both strict legal nature and serious policy nature; it must achieve good legal effects as well as good social and political effects, fully reflecting policy orientation. People's courts at all levels must adhere to justice for the people and fair justice, strictly follow the unified requirements of the central authorities, promptly identify and correct property rights dispute appeal cases that have aroused strong social reactions, analyze cases infringing upon property rights, summarize and publicize good cases of effective property rights protection, continuously enrich and accumulate judicial experience in property rights protection, strive to improve the precision of property rights protection, and work hard to promote the rule of law in property rights protection.

II. Clarify the objectives, tasks, and overall requirements

4. Clarify the scope of case handling. For property rights disputes involving major property dispositions made since the reform and opening up, as well as effective judgments and rulings regarding criminal offenses by private enterprises and investors, if the parties or third parties file an appeal, the people's court shall promptly examine and seriously identify them; if there are actual errors, they must be resolutely corrected according to law.

5. Highlight work priorities. Focus on the identification, correction, and publicity of major typical cases. Pay attention to clarifying the facts and focal issues of the cases, clarifying relevant legal and policy issues, understanding the background and social reactions of the cases, accurately applying laws and relevant policy provisions, and handling them properly. For key cases, formulate a package work plan including case filing, retrial, enforcement, and aftermath for each case.

III. Correctly grasp the working principles

6. Adhere to the principle of seeking truth from facts. Respect history, seek truth from facts, and objectively view and lawfully and properly handle the non-standard issues existing in the operation of various enterprises, especially private enterprises, since the reform and opening up, with a developmental perspective.

7. Adhere to the principle of equal protection. Provide equal judicial protection for all types of property rights subjects, adhere to the principle that everyone is equal before the law, smooth the case filing channels for property rights appeal cases, standardize the application of retrial procedures, ensure equal litigation status, equal litigation rights, and equal application of law.

8. Adhere to the principle of correcting errors according to law. Adhere to the principle of taking facts as the basis and law as the criterion, strictly follow the principles of non-retroactivity of laws, nulla poena sine lege, lex mitior (the more lenient law applies between the old and new laws), and strictly observe legal procedures. For appeal cases meeting the conditions for retrial, initiate retrial procedures according to law; for effective judgments and rulings with actual errors, resolutely correct them to maintain fairness and justice and enhance judicial credibility.

9. Adhere to the principle of combining correction and prevention. Through the identification and correction of property rights wrongful and unjust cases, strengthen the functions of trial supervision judicial relief, forcing error prevention, and unifying the application of law; implement the judicial responsibility system and strengthen prevention at the source.

IV. Strictly follow the procedures for identifying and correcting

10. Protect litigation rights. Smooth appeal channels and provide litigation services. Fully respect and legally protect the parties' rights to apply, appeal, information, statement, defense, debate, and disposition.

11. Strengthen procedural supervision. For property rights appeal cases, strengthen supervision at different trial levels. If the higher court can bring up the case for trial and change the judgment, it should not instruct the lower court to retry or remand for retrial. Strengthen supervision and guidance over the lower courts in handling property rights cases to prevent procedural waste. Attach importance to procuratorial supervision and handle cases of protests and procuratorial recommendations filed by the procuratorial organ according to law.

12. Maintain procedural fairness. Implement the requirements for receiving and talking to parties, improve inquiry methods, and fully listen to the opinions of the appellant. Highlight the trial function, focus on reasoning in judgments, and strengthen judicial openness. Strengthen judicial aid and legal aid to alleviate burdens for private enterprises and investors involved in litigation who are genuinely in difficulty.

V. Prudently grasp judicial policies

13. Accurately grasp the legal and policy boundaries between crime and non-crime. Strictly distinguish between economic disputes and economic crimes, especially the boundaries between contract disputes and contract fraud; between legitimate corporate financing and illegal fund-raising; and between economic disputes involved in the merger and reorganization of private enterprises with state-owned enterprises and malicious encroachment of state-owned assets. Accurately grasp the standards for criminalizing economic violations, accurately determine the nature of economic disputes and economic crimes, and resolutely correct erroneous effective judgments that treat economic disputes as crimes. For economic behaviors in production, operation, financing, and other activities, if the laws and administrative regulations at the time did not explicitly prohibit them but they were convicted as crimes, or if they were illegal or irregular but did not constitute crimes yet were convicted as crimes, all should be corrected according to law.

14. Resolutely correct erroneous cases resulting from the involvement of criminal enforcement in civil disputes. For cases where criminal means were used to force a party to express intent, leading to erroneous effective civil judgments, resolutely correct them. For investors in private enterprises involved in crimes, during the period when the party is subjected to compulsory measures or serving a sentence, ensure that they can exercise property rights and other civil rights according to law. For private enterprise investors whose exercise of civil litigation rights is seriously affected due to restrictions on personal freedom, after the restriction on personal freedom is lifted, if new evidence is provided regarding the facts of the civil case that may overturn the effective judgment, the people's court shall investigate and verify ex officio; if the conditions for retrial are met, it shall initiate retrial according to law.

15. Lawfully and properly handle appeal cases arising from property mixing. When identifying and retrying property rights cases, strictly distinguish between individual property and the property of legal persons of the enterprise. For cases involving violations by natural persons such as shareholders and business managers, pay attention to examining whether the enterprise's legal person property was arbitrarily implicated when disposing of their individual property; for cases involving violations by the enterprise, when disposing of the enterprise's legal person property, pay attention to examining whether the personal legal property of shareholders, business managers, and other individuals was arbitrarily implicated. Strictly distinguish between illegal gains and legal property, and between the personal property of the person involved and the property of their family members. Pay attention to examining whether the legal property of the person involved or the legal property of their family members was implicated when disposing of illegal gains, and whether there were illegal disposals of property involved in the case, especially whether the legitimate rights and interests of the parties and their close relatives, shareholders, creditors, and other related parties were infringed upon. If property rights are indeed damaged due to erroneous effective judgments, correct according to law and compensate the parties for their losses.

16. Lawfully and properly handle property rights appeal cases related to government actions. When identifying and retrying property rights cases, for various contracts signed with investment entities according to law in activities such as investment attraction and government-social capital cooperation, if the government defaults or breaches the contract due to changes in government or leadership changes, infringing upon the legitimate rights and interests of the investment entity, or if the government changes its promises and contract terms due to statutory reasons without legally compensating the investment entity for property losses incurred, the people's court shall retry and change the judgment according to law. For erroneous judgments where the government did not provide fair and reasonable compensation to the expropriated or requisitioned person in accordance with the scope, form, and standards of compensation during the expropriation or requisition of property such as land and houses, the people's court shall examine according to law and initiate retrial. During the retrial examination and hearing, pay attention to using administrative reconciliation and coordination mechanisms and civil mediation methods to properly resolve property disputes.

17. Lawfully and properly handle appeal cases involving property disposition. If property rights of a party, interested party, or third party are infringed due to erroneous implementation of preservation measures, erroneous enforcement measures, or erroneous disposal of the subject matter of enforcement, promptly lift or change the compulsory measures, reverse enforcement, or return the property. If dissatisfied with the ruling on an objection to the subject matter of enforcement during the enforcement process, the parties or third parties may seek relief through legal channels such as enforcement objection lawsuits or trial supervision procedures; if damage is caused, the victim has the right to apply for state compensation in accordance with the law.

18. Lawfully try state compensation cases involving property rights protection. For state compensation arising from property rights appeal cases, conduct serious examination, file cases according to law if the conditions for case filing are met, and compensate according to law if the conditions for compensation are met. Adhere to the principle of statutory compensation and strengthen the enforcement of compensation decisions.

VI. Seize implementation with a firm grip

19. Uphold the leadership of the Party. Improving the property rights protection system and legally protecting property rights are a major decision and deployment made by the Party Central Committee and the State Council. People's courts at all levels should consciously place the judicial protection of property rights under the unified leadership of the Party and adhere to the independent exercise of adjudicative power according to law. For major matters in property rights protection, promptly report to the local Party committee, and under the overall coordination of the Party committee, collaborate with relevant departments to form a joint force for handling property rights appeal cases.

20. Establish a coordination mechanism. Each High People's Court shall strengthen the organization and leadership of the identification and correction of property rights wrongful and unjust cases, establish a special working group, strengthen overall coordination, propose work plans, study and resolve prominent issues, establish and improve emergency plans for sensitive cases, strengthen guidance to lower courts, and promptly report work progress. The office of the working group shall be uniformly established within the Trial Supervision Division.

21. Do a good job of publicity and guidance. Highlight the focus and policy orientation of publicity, strengthen information disclosure, and promptly respond to social concerns. Timely release typical cases of property rights protection to the public. Strengthen legal interpretation and policy guidance, actively promote the concept of rule of law in property rights protection, and create a good judicial environment and public opinion atmosphere for property rights protection.

22. Strictly enforce discipline and accountability. During the identification and correction of property rights appeal cases, conscientiously implement systems such as the "Provisions on the Recording, Notification, and Accountability of Leading Cadres Interfering in Judicial Activities and Intervening in the Handling of Specific Cases" and the "Several Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Improving the Judicial Responsibility System," further improve the system of lifelong responsibility for case handling quality and the system of retrospective investigation and accountability for wrongful cases, and effectively prevent the occurrence of wrongful and unjust cases at the source.
